title: AuditEntry
description: One line of the append-only, hash-chained audit log. `hash` is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, RFC 8785 style) of the entry without its `hash` field. `prev` is the previous entry's hash; the first entry uses 64 zeros. The format is language-neutral so PHP and other sidecars can write and verify the same chain.
